data.title: China Railway Signal & Communication Reports 14 Rail Transit Project Awards
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from China Railway Signal & Communication ( (HK:3969) ).

China Railway Signal & Communication Corporation Limited said it was awarded 14 important projects from September to October 2026, including 11 railway projects and three urban rail transit projects. Railway awards included the RMB1.299 billion Jincheng special railway project, Mexico City’s AIFA-PACHUCA railway project at MXN1.37 billion, approximately RMB507 million, and projects involving the Qinghai-Tibet Railway, 350 km/h Fuxing EMUs and a Kazakhstan railway.

The urban rail awards cover communication, signaling, monitoring, access control, fire systems, fare collection and platform screen doors for extensions or upgrades involving Shanghai Metro Lines 12 and 19 and Dongguan Rail Transit Line 2. The disclosed projects span domestic and overseas markets and include EPC-plus-operation, electrification, train-control, onboard equipment and integrated urban rail systems work.

data.title: China New Energy Updates Plan for 2025 Audit Disclaimer
data.description:
China New Energy ( (HK:1156) ) has shared an announcement.

The company said material uncertainty over the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern led its auditor to issue a disclaimer of opinion on the consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025. It reported that it had formulated an action plan covering financing, capital management and measures to improve its financial position and address the underlying factors behind the disclaimer.

The first placing, completed on 15 July 2026, involved 117,951,779 shares and generated net proceeds of approximately HK$19.59 million; the company reallocated HK$9.59 million to general working capital and HK$10 million to new subsidiaries and expansion. A second placing of up to 117,951,779 shares at HK$0.161 each was disclosed as conditional on listing approval and other conditions, with its long-stop date extended to 14 December 2026.

data.title: Jakota Capital Sets Out Audit Committee Terms of Reference
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Kingkey Financial International (Holdings) Ltd. ( (HK:1468) ).

The release sets out the terms of reference for Jakota Capital (Holding) Group’s Audit Committee, which assists the board with financial reporting, risk management, internal controls and its relationship with auditors. The committee must have at least three non-executive directors, a majority independent, and an independently chaired member with relevant accounting or financial expertise.

Members are appointed and removed by the board, with independence and former-auditor restrictions applying under the Hong Kong Listing Rules. The committee has a quorum of two, may invite management and auditors without voting rights, must meet at least twice yearly to review interim and annual statements, and must meet external auditors at least twice a year.

data.title: Prosperous Future Proposes Auditor Change to Grant Thornton
data.description:
The latest update is out from Prosperous Future Holdings ( (HK:1259) ).

Prosperous Future Holdings has proposed changing its external auditor from BDO Limited to Grant Thornton Hong Kong Limited after the company and BDO failed to reach agreement on the proposed audit fee for the year ending 31 December 2026. BDO has resigned, while the board and audit committee said there is no disagreement beyond the fee issue and no other matters requiring shareholder attention.

The audit committee assessed GT as independent, competent and capable of performing a high-quality audit, citing its governance, ethical compliance, listed-company experience and proposed audit plan. The change was proposed after the board compared audit proposals from BDO and other firms, while BDO had not commenced FY2026 fieldwork.

data.title: Modern Dental Group Revenue Rises 9.3% in Nine Months
data.description:
An announcement from Modern Dental Group Limited ( (HK:3600) ) is now available.

Modern Dental Group operates in the dental industry and dental prosthetics sector, with international production facilities in Thailand, Vietnam and Mainland China. Its customer markets include Europe, North America, Greater China, Australia and other regions, while the company said digitalization is driving consolidation in dental prosthetics and its transformation initiatives are enhancing customer and patient experiences and operational efficiency.

For the nine months ended 30 September 2026, the Group reported approximately HK$3,009.0 million in revenue, up 9.3% from approximately HK$2,752.4 million a year earlier. The increase came amid softer demand for dental procedures and trade and geopolitical uncertainties; Europe and Australia grew in original currency, while North America declined.

data.title: ICBC Completes Redemption of 2021 Undated Additional Tier 1 Capital Bonds
data.description:

Under the issuance terms, the bank had the right to redeem the bonds in full at face value on the dividend payment date of the fifth interest accrual year, 26 November 2026. The bank exercised that right and completed the full redemption as at the announcement date, 27 November 2026.
